mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.3pp in 3 months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines > 1% MoM and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) above 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases > 0.3pp and PAYEMS decreases > 100k in 3 months
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.3pp and PAYEMS decreases > 100k in 3 months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a decline in real final sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening of demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 5% MoM and RSAFS declines > 1% MoM
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 5% MoM and RSAFS declines > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 2% QoQ signals strengthening economic conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases > 2% QoQ and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered instances.
